dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 jacket water temperature climbed from 162F to 184F in about 8 minutes, starting around 4:21 PM. It kept rising after load was cut to 60%, while U1 and U3 held at 162F. Ambient is 15F. Controlled stop at 4:29 PM before trip. Need field check of the U2 cooling system (cooler fan/belt, louvers, jacket water level/pump, thermostat, possible freeze) and of the temperature transmitter. Gas control is short on capacity and wants U2 back as soon as it is safe.
